patch_description: This edit implements coarse-grained parameter sharing for RY and RZ gates, grouping qubits [0–3] and [4–7] to reduce parameter count and regularize the model. It also re-introduces the post-rotation RZ layer (which was missing in the current version) and restores the effective interleaved CZ entanglement rings that performed well in prior experiments. This structure should improve the generalization gap and parameter efficiency.
